description: Rewords a memory of the slides agent, or moves it to one report or all of them. What you send changes and the rest stays. Answers the memory.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

reportId.description: The report the memory holds for, by its `id` from `listReports`, which you must be able to edit. `null` for all your reports. If omitted, it stays.

text.description: What the slides agent should remember, as one plain sentence, at most 300 characters.
examples: Our fiscal year starts in February

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

memoryId.description: The memory to act on, by its `id` from `listMemories`.

name: updateMemory
title: Update memory
